description: This file implements the PackageManager class for a plugin in the WPEFramework, handling initialization, deinitialization, and remote connection management, including registration of package downloaders, installers, and handlers.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Implements the package management functionalities including initialization, cleanup, and remote connection handling within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: PackageManager::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the PackageManager, sets up package downloader, installer, and handler, and registers notification sinks.

methods.name: PackageManager::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notification sinks, and releases remote connections.

methods.name: PackageManager::Information
methods.description: Returns a string with package manager information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: PackageManager::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles remote connection deactivation, potentially triggering cleanup or shutdown procedures.
